title: Al amaan al amaan
body:
Al amaan al amaan
YABNAZ ZAHRA-9
ALLAHUMMA AJJIL LE WALIYEKAL FARAJ.
Al amaa'n-6 ya SAHIBAZ ZAMA'N
al amaa'n-al amaa'n ya SAHIBAZ ZAMA'N-3
Tooti hui hain aaj bhi-2 ZAHRA ki pasliya'n.
<<MINI>>
Al amaa'n...-2
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Haq mangne Jo FATEMA darbar me gayin, Baithe rahe the log kisi ne haya na KI, ZAINAB KI maa khadi rahi-2
Logo'n k darmiya'n.
<<MINI>>
Al amaa'n-4
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Wa hurmata BUTOOL pe kaisi thi wo ghadi
Tumko sadayen deti thi beti RASOOL ki, Diwar or jalte hue dar k darmiya'n.
<<MINI>>
Al amaa'n...-4
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Dhati rahi sitam pe sitam ummat e RASOOL, Deti rahi azaan e wilayat wahan BATOOL, ASHADO ANNA ALI UN WALI ULLAH
ZAHRA KI baat sunta-2 nahi tha koi jahan.
<<MINI>>
Al amaa'n..-4
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Darbar se jo laut k Binte NABI gayin, Guzre na us maqaam se MOLA HASAN kabhi, Jis kooch me giri thi-2 zami'n par HASAN KI maa.
<<MINI>>
Al Amaa'n.
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Aabaad hoga phir se wo ujda hua dayaar, Tab hoga khatm Fatema SUGHRA ka intezar, AKBAR KI tarha doge-2 madine me jab azaa'n
ALLAH HO AKBAR
<<MINI>>
Al amaa'n.
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Tanhayi qaid hurre yateemi andhera Ghar, Had hai KI koi jabhi NAhi sakta qabr par, Ab or kitna hoga SAKINA ka imteha'n.
<<MINI>>
Al amaa'n..-4
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Kadiyal jawa'n ko roti hai turbat me aaj bhi
AKBAR k to kaleje as barchi nikal gayi, ZAINAB k dil SE nikli-2 nahi aaj tak sina.
<<MINI>>
Al amaa'n..-4
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Bali SAKINA qaid me zinda'n me aaj bhi, AKBAR hai intezar me beti HUSSAIN KI, Ab bhi sunayi deti hai-2 bacchi KI hichkiya'n.
Al Amaa'n ya SAHIBUZ ZAMA'N
ALLAH HUMMMA AJJIL LE WALIYEKAL FARAJ
